The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1904–1905''' was contested by eighteen teams participating in two divisions. The western division had been divided during the last two seasons, but was combined again. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern and western football division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[HVV Den Haag]] won this year's championship by beating [[EFC PW 1885|PW]] 4-1 and 4–2.

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*[[RKVV Wilhelmina]]

'''Eerste Klasse West:'''
*[[Dordrechtse Football Club|DFC]]
*[[HV & CV Quick]]
